content:
While 2025 is a year of pilot projects in the tech world, 2026 stands out as a period when these experiments translate into operational results. Businesses now view artificial intelligence technologies not merely as a tool, but as a strategic necessity at the heart of their business processes.

Technological Transformation and Agent Systems

AI systems are evolving from screen-based applications to structures capable of making decisions in the physical world. The key concepts emerging in this process are as follows:

  • Agentic AI: Autonomous systems that carry out tasks toward specific goals without human intervention.
  • Multiagent Systems: Architectures in which AI agents with different areas of expertise collaborate to make autonomous decisions and directly impact the P&L.
  • Physical AI: Robotics and autonomous vehicles playing an active role on production lines and in warehouses to perform tasks in the physical world.

Infrastructure and Security Architecture

With the increase in data usage and token costs, businesses are transitioning from fully cloud-focused strategies to hybrid models (cloud, edge computing, and on-premises deployment). Confidential Computing technologies ensure that data is encrypted during processing, while digital asset verification processes are gaining importance.

On the cybersecurity front, the use of AI-based preemptive defense mechanisms (Preemptive Cybersecurity) against AI-powered attacks has become a necessity. Legacy perimeter defense models are proving inadequate against threats that evolve at machine speed.

Organizational Structure

Traditional organizational structures are undergoing transformation due to the influence of automation and no-code platforms. Large organizations are being replaced by agile micro-teams of 2–4 people—empowered by AI-powered tools—and structures centered on solopreneurs. In this new era, success lies not in patching technology onto existing processes, but in rebuilding the entire architecture based on the principles of “secure-by-design and digital-by-default.”
